title: Private Monterey Walking Food Tour with Local Tastings
includes: Craft beer tasting flight (non-alcoholic alternative available)
requirements: Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: All sales are final. No refund is available for cancellations.
blurb: This private walking food tour lets you discover Monterey through authentic local flavors and fascinating history. Walk along the famous waterfront with a professional local guide while enjoying carefully selected tastings. Begin with Monterey's celebrated clam chowder before sampling regional craft beer. Continue through the historic district where fresh pastries add another local favorite to your journey. Finish with handcrafted ice cream prepared using seasonal ingredients. Along the route you will hear stories about Monterey's fishing traditions and vibrant community. Every stop combines culture with memorable flavors while keeping a relaxed walking pace. All featured tastings are included in the tour price. Please note: The program and attractions may vary based on booking date/time and crowd conditions, ensuring each visit is a unique experience.
